info.name: Assignment01 - Task09 baseline (zero fee)
info.description: Nimsara, EC/2022/052, BECS32263. Run in listed order ONCE against fresh seed data with bank.transfer.fee-rate=0. Body type is form-urlencoded, redirects stay enabled. This reproduces the seven Task9 cases; 05 and06 are split into separate requests. Initial seed guard stops the runner on changed data.

item.name: 00 - Initial seed and safe starting-state guard

exec: const expected = {'Total balance (LKR)': total, 'Successful transfers': successful, 'Failed transfers': failed};

const fresh = accountBalance('100001') === 50000 && accountBalance('100002') === 25000 && accountBalance('100003') === 10000 && accountBalance('999999') === 0 && statValue('Successful transfers') === 0 && statValue('Failed transfers') === 0 && statValue('Customers') === 3;
pm.test('Fresh seed data guard: stop runner if database is already changed', () => pm.expect(fresh).to.equal(true));
